function musicTick(){const nm=!musicOn?"":S==="play"?(lvl===9?"tut":(boss.active&&!boss.dead)?"boss"+boss.k:"L"+lvl):(S==="win"||S==="over")?"":"menu";
 if(nm!==tName){if(nm===""&&musicOn&&(S==="win"||S==="over"))jingle(S==="win");tName=nm;tStep=0}
 let dl=200;const ok=AC&&AC.state==="running";
 if(nm&&TRK[nm]){const T=TRK[nm];dl=30000/T.bpm;if(ok){const i=tStep%T.l.length,d=hx(T.l[i]),sec=dl/1000;if(d<99)sfx(mf(dg(T.r+12,T.s,d)),sec*1.5,T.w,.03);
  if(tStep%4===0)sfx(mf(dg(T.r-12,T.s,hx(T.b[(tStep>>2)%T.b.length]))),sec*3.2,"sine",.05);
  if(tStep%8===0)sfx(120,.1,"sine",.07,-70);if(T.bpm>=120&&tStep%2===1)sfx(9000,.02,"square",.01);if(nm[0]==="b"&&tStep%8===4)sfx(190,.06,"sawtooth",.03,-110)}tStep++}
 setTimeout(musicTick,dl)}
setTimeout(musicTick,300);
// ---- estados
function runEnd(){if(!inRun)return;inRun=false;plays++;if(plays>=5){plays=0;Object.keys(ups).forEach(k=>ups[k]=0);noticeTxt="¡Pasaron 5 partidas! Tus mejoras de la tienda desaparecieron. Tus monedas se quedan.";noticeUntil=performance.now()+9000}save()}
function newGame(n){inRun=n!==9;lvl=n;score=0;coinsN=0;lives=DIFS[dif].lv+ups.lf;startLevel()}
function startLevel(){build();S="play";time=0;sfx(660,.15,"square",.06,400)}
function toMenu(){S="menu";shake=0;runEnd();save()}
const act={play:()=>newGame(clamp(lvl,0,unlocked-1)),next:()=>{lvl++;startLevel()},retry:()=>newGame(lvl)};
// ---- entrada
const inp={l:false,r:false,j:false,jp:false,at:false,mb:false,ck:false};
const KM={ArrowLeft:"l",a:"l",A:"l",ArrowRight:"r",d:"r",D:"r",j:"at",J:"at",x:"at",X:"at",k:"at",z:"at",Z:"at"},JK=["ArrowUp","w","W"," "];
addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.target&&e.target.tagName==="INPUT")return;if(KM[e.key]){inp[KM[e.key]]=true;e.preventDefault()}else if(JK.includes(e.key)){if(!inp.j)inp.jp=true;inp.j=true;e.preventDefault()}
 else if(e.key==="Enter"){if(S==="menu")act.play();else if(S==="over")act.retry();else if(S==="win"&&lvl<5)act.next()}
 else if(e.key==="Escape"&&S!=="menu")toMenu();else if(e.key==="m"||e.key==="M"){musicOn=!musicOn;$("mu").textContent=musicOn?"🎵":"🔇"}});
addEventListener("keyup",e=>{if(e.target&&e.target.tagName==="INPUT")return;if(KM[e.key])inp[KM[e.key]]=false;else if(JK.includes(e.key))inp.j=false});
const bind=(id,k)=>{const b=$(id);const on=e=>{e.preventDefault();b.classList.add("on");if(k==="j"&&!inp.j)inp.jp=true;inp[k]=true},off=e=>{e.preventDefault();b.classList.remove("on");inp[k]=false};b.addEventListener("pointerdown",on);["pointerup","pointerleave","pointercancel"].forEach(n=>b.addEventListener(n,off))};
bind("bl","l");bind("br","r");bind("ba","at");bind("bj","j");
const setMs=e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();ms.x=(e.clientX-r.left)*W/r.width;ms.y=(e.clientY-r.top)*H/r.height;ms.t=performance.now();ms.pt=e.pointerType||"mouse"};
cv.addEventListener("pointermove",setMs);
cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{setMs(e);if(S==="play"){if(e.button===0||e.pointerType!=="mouse"){inp.ck=true;inp.mb=true}}else{for(const b of btns)if(!b.dis&&ms.x>=b.x&&ms.x<=b.x+b.w&&ms.y>=b.y&&ms.y<=b.y+b.h){sfx(700,.08,"square",.05,300);b.fn();break}}});
addEventListener("pointerup",()=>{inp.mb=false});cv.addEventListener("contextmenu",e=>e.preventDefault());
$("mu").onclick=()=>{musicOn=!musicOn;$("mu").textContent=musicOn?"🎵":"🔇"};$("mn").onclick=()=>{if(S!=="menu")toMenu()};
// ---- utilidades
const pop=(x,y,t)=>pops.push({x,y,t,l:.8});
const burst=(x,y,col,n)=>{for(let i=0;i<n;i++)parts.push({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*300,vy:-Math.random()*320,l:.7+Math.random()*.4,c:col})};
const add=(n,x,y)=>{score+=n;if(x!=null)pop(x,y,"+"+n)};
function hurt(){if(p.inv>0||p.sh>0||S!=="play")return;p.hp--;p.inv=1.6;p.vy=-320;p.vx=-p.f*180;shake=.25;sfx(180,.3,"sawtooth",.08,-120);if(p.hp<=0)die()}
function die(){if(lvl!==9&&!(ups.rv&&!rvUsed))lives--;else if(lvl!==9){rvUsed=true;pop(p.x,p.y-30,"¡SEGUNDA OPORTUNIDAD!")}sfx(300,.6,"square",.07,-250);if(lives<=0){S="over";save();endRun();runEnd();return}
 p.x=cp;p.y=12*T-56;p.vx=p.vy=0;p.hp=HPM();p.inv=1.5;p.sh=p.dj=p.bg=p.spd=0;
 if(boss.active&&!boss.dead){resetBoss();balls=[];enemies=enemies.filter(e=>e.x<AR*T);for(let r=3;r<12;r++)G[r][AR]=0;gateOpen=true}}
function spawnItem(c,r){if(lvl!==9&&Math.random()>.6-.1*HD())return;let k=[0,0,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,4][Math.floor(Math.random()*10)];if(k===0&&p.hp>=HPM())k=2;items.push({x:c*T+5,y:r*T-24,w:22,h:22,vx:0,vy:-260,k,ground:false});sfx(660,.15,"triangle",.07,500)}
function bump(c,r){const t=G[r][c];if(t===3){G[r][c]=4;gc();add(200,c*T+8,r*T-6);sfx(988,.08,"square",.06);sfx(1319,.2,"square",.06);burst(c*T+16,r*T,"#ffd166",6);spawnItem(c,r)}
 else if(t===2){G[r][c]=0;add(50,c*T+8,r*T);sfx(150,.15,"square",.06,-60);burst(c*T+16,r*T+16,th.br,10)}}
const plantBox=pl=>{const q=((time+pl.ph)%3.4)/3.4,near=Math.abs(p.x+p.w/2-pl.x)<46;let f=q<.15?q/.15:q<.55?1:q<.7?(.7-q)/.15:0;if(near)f=0;pl.f=f;return{x:pl.x-14,y:pl.top-f*40,w:28,h:f*40}};
const swingA=(a,q)=>{const s=Math.cos(a)>=0?1:-1,e=Math.min(1,q/.65);return a+s*(-1.3+2.6*(1-(1-e)*(1-e)))};

function update(dt){
 if(S!==prevS){prevS=S;endT=0;if(S==="win"||S==="over")set3D(S==="win")}if(S==="win"||S==="over")endT+=dt;if(S==="win")wonT+=dt;if(S!=="play")return;
 time+=dt;shake=Math.max(0,shake-dt);const D=DIFS[dif],DM=D.sp*(1+(lvl===9?0:lvl)*.08)*(1+.1*HD()),RX=RUN*(p.spd>0?1.35:1)*(1+.12*ups.spd);p.sh=Math.max(0,p.sh-dt);p.dj=Math.max(0,p.dj-dt);p.bg=Math.max(0,p.bg-dt);p.spd=Math.max(0,p.spd-dt);
 const ax=(inp.r?1:0)-(inp.l?1:0),SX=p.x+p.w/2,SY=p.y+p.h-38,aimOn=performance.now()-ms.t<(ms.pt==="mouse"?4000:500);
 if(ax){p.vx+=ax*2300*dt;p.f=ax}else p.vx-=Math.sign(p.vx)*Math.min(Math.abs(p.vx),1900*dt);

 // jefe

     if(r<.3){const a=Math.atan2(p.y+p.h/2-(b.y+40),p.x-b.x),n=fury?3:1;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const an=a+(i-(n-1)/2)*.3;balls.push({x:b.x+b.w/2,y:b.y+40,vx:Math.cos(an)*215,vy:Math.sin(an)*215,l:0})}sfx(300,.3,"sawtooth",.06,-150)}

let DB=null,UID=null,canW=null,board=[],lbState="loading",lbDif=-1,unsub=null,nick="Jugador",hasNick=false,bests=[0,0,0];
const SNAP={t:Date.UTC(2026,10,21),b:[[],[],[]]};
try{nick=localStorage.getItem("stk_n")||"Jugador";hasNick=!!localStorage.getItem("stk_n");const b=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("stk_bs")||"[0,0,0]");if(Array.isArray(b))bests=[b[0]|0,b[1]|0,b[2]|0]}catch(e){}
(async()=>{try{const c=window.claude;if(!c||!c.use){lbState="off";return}const db=await c.use("db"),us=await c.use("user");if(!db||!us){lbState="off";return}UID=await us.id();try{canW=await us.can("data.write")}catch(e){}DB=db;lbState=UID?"on":"off";if(UID&&S==="rank")subBoard(lbDif<0?dif:lbDif)}catch(e){lbState="off"}})();
function subBoard(d){lbDif=d;board=[];if(unsub){try{unsub()}catch(e){}unsub=null}if(!DB||!UID)return;lbState="load";
 try{unsub=DB.collection("scores").orderBy("b"+d,"desc").limit(10).onSnapshot(s=>{board=s.docs.map(x=>Object.assign({id:x.id},x.data())).filter(o=>o["b"+d]>0);lbState="on"},e=>{lbState="err"})}catch(e){lbState="err"}}
async function postScore(){if(!DB||!UID||canW===false)return;try{const ref=DB.collection("scores").doc(UID),s=await ref.get(),o=s.exists?s.data():{},d={n:nick,t:Date.now()};let ch=o.n!==nick;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const v=Math.max(o["b"+i]||0,bests[i]);if(v>0)d["b"+i]=v;if(v!==(o["b"+i]||0))ch=true}if(ch)await ref.set(d)}catch(e){if(e&&e.code==="invalid_argument")canW=false}}
function endRun(){if(lvl===9||score<=0)return;bests[dif]=Math.max(bests[dif],score);try{localStorage.setItem("stk_bs",JSON.stringify(bests))}catch(e){}postScore()}
$("nsave").onclick=()=>{const v=($("nick").value||"").trim().slice(0,12);if(!v){$("nick").style.outline="2px solid #ef4444";return}$("nick").style.outline="";nick=v;try{localStorage.setItem("stk_n",nick)}catch(e){}postScore()};
$("nmgo").onclick=()=>{const v=($("nmin").value||"").trim().slice(0,12);if(!v){$("nmerr").style.display="block";return}nick=v;hasNick=true;try{localStorage.setItem("stk_n",nick)}catch(e){}$("nm").style.display="none";S="menu";postScore()};
$("nmin").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")$("nmgo").click()});

 else{const sag=Math.min(1,t/.9);P.G.position.y=-.15*sag;P.bodyG.rotation.x=.38*sag;P.headG.rotation.set(.45*sag,0,.1*sag);P.mouth.rotation.z=0;P.mouth.position.y=-.2;
